name: Ghostty
description:
Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, cross-platform terminal emulator designed by Mitchell Hashimoto. Built from the ground up in Zig, it leverages GPU hardware acceleration to deliver ultra-low latency and rich terminal capabilities.

Features:
- GPU-accelerated text rendering delivering instant keystroke response and high throughput
- True native desktop integration with support for tabs, splits, and custom fonts
- Advanced terminal standards support including Kitty graphics protocol and 24-bit RGB truecolor
- Broad font rendering support with ligatures, bold, italic, and emoji fallbacks
- Low memory usage and clean, minimalist configuration system
